Handle DMI response: capture dmi_rsp_i.data into dmi_ctrl.rdata and clear busy when ack is observed

dmi_ctrl.busy acts as a lock that prevents new DMI requests from being started while a transaction is in flight

concepts.reasoning: The module composes tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt (lines 219-226) and stores it into tap_reg.dtmcs on DR_CAPTURE (line 188). concepts.reasoning: The IREG value is loaded on IR_CAPTURE/IR_SHIFT (lines 178-181) and the design uses it to select which register is captured/shifted/read on DR states and which data appear on TDO (lines 185-197, 202-211). Corrupting IREG changes which register is accessed; the map shows tap_reg.ireg is a clocked register (CLOCKED_BY clk_i) and it is the selector for the DR/IR logic.

concepts.reasoning: The two-bit shift register dr_trigger.sreg captures DR_UPDATE events in the update_trigger process and dr_trigger.valid is asserted when sreg="01" (lines 151-156, 161). The DMI controller and DTMCS logic use dr_trigger.valid to permit copying of tapped-in values into controller state (lines 247-265). The map shows dr_trigger.sreg as a clocked register (CLOCKED_BY clk_i) and dr_trigger.valid computed from sreg (GATED_BY at its occurrence).

concepts.concept: DMI controller busy flag that blocks new request acceptance until the outstanding DMI completes
concepts.reasoning: The busy register is asserted by the controller when it begins handling a DMI op (lines 269-271) and is the gate that prevents new request setup (lines 263-266, 270-271). If busy is corrupted the controller could incorrectly accept or reject requests; the map shows dmi_ctrl.busy is a clocked register (CLOCKED_BY clk_i) and used as a control-only source that gates address/op/wdata updates and response handling.

concepts.reasoning: The controller sets err on certain conditions (line 259) and clears it on reset or on DMI reset (lines 256-258). The readback into the DMI DR encodes err bits (tap_reg.dmi_nxt includes replicate_f(dmi_ctrl.err,2) at line 229), so err's integrity affects what the host reads. The map shows dmi_ctrl.err is a clocked register and that tap_reg.dmi_nxt DERIVES_FROM dmi_ctrl.err (occurrence/records cited in the structural references).
